test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under Article 165, the Governor appoints a person who is qualified to be appointed a Judge of a High Court to be the ________ for the State.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Advocate-General**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Under **Article 165** of the Constitution of India, the **Governor** appoints the **Advocate-General** for the state.
 
• The Advocate-General must be qualified to be appointed as a **Judge of a High Court**.
 
• This means the person must have been an advocate for at least **10 years** or a judicial officer for at least **10 years**.
 
• The Advocate-General is the highest law officer in the state and advises the **state government** on legal matters.
 
• The Advocate-General has the right to participate in the proceedings of the state legislature and express views, but they do not have the right to vote.
 
• The position is analogous to the **Attorney General of India** at the central level.
 
• The Advocate-General performs duties such as defending the state in legal cases and representing the state in legal matters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chief Minister**__

 __
 
• The **Chief Minister** is the elected head of the government in a state and is not appointed by the Governor under Article 165.
 
• The Chief Minister is chosen by the majority party or coalition in the state legislature.
 
• He/she acts as the chief executive of the state, overseeing the administration and implementing policies.
 
 
 
• **Attorney General**__
 __
 
• The **Attorney General** is the highest law officer in the country and is appointed by the President of India under **Article 76**.
 
• The Attorney General advises the central government on legal matters and represents the government in cases before the Supreme Court.
 
• This position is not related to Article 165, which deals with states.
 
 
 
• **Comptroller Auditor General (CAG)**__
 
 
• The **Comptroller Auditor General** is appointed by the President of India under **Article 148**.
 
• The CAG is responsible for auditing government expenditures and ensuring accountability in financial matters.
 
• This position is unrelated to Article 165 or legal advice to state governments.
